gloss: senior in age; older; the eldest

definitions.gloss: senior in age; older; the eldest
definitions.explanation: Being older than others, or a person who is older. Used both as a noun and, with の, as a modifier. The opposite of {年少|ねんしょう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{年長|ねんちょう}だ。
{年長|ねんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敬|うやま}う→敬う：00417_uyamau⟧。
⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{年長|ねんちょう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧だ。
examples.english: She is the oldest one in the group.

notes:
Being older in age, or the older person; the opposite of ⟦{年少|ねんしょう}→年少：29613_nenshou⟧. Works as a noun and, with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年長|ねんちょう}{者|しゃ}: an elder; a senior person
- {年長|ねんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an older person
- ⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{年長|ねんちょう}: the eldest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧: older — the everyday word, always relative to another specific person
- ⟦{年少|ねんしょう}→年少：29613_nenshou⟧: younger; junior — the antonym
